fixed_portal_donor_transplants.sampling: Up to 16 donor templates per component and length; additional templates stop after candidate count exceeds 300. Internal runs of 5 to 48 vertices eligible. Length offsets 0, 2, 4, -2.

shifted_portal_donor_transplants.sampling: Two randomly sampled neighboring seam positions per eligible interface, can repeat. Up to six donors per inspected length, length change up to four in either direction, stop after candidate count exceeds 300.
